what: QED failure and recovery, live on an isolated scratch copy

steps.name: services up and a live rupee price for bitcoin is arriving
the payment reached the rail and is pending there
the API records the approved order but nothing executes it
with the engine dead the API says so
on restart the engine writes down the time it was not running
steps.observed: 2026-11-22 12:01:33.496 IST to 2026-11-22 12:02:06.269 IST (33 s): The engine process was not running. Detected at start-up from the last heartbeat.

steps.name: back on stale prices, the order waits for a fresh one and then executes once
steps.expected: done; one venue order; decided after the restart
steps.observed: done; venue orders 1; asked 2026-11-22 12:01:36.097 IST, decided 2026-11-22 12:02:07.297 IST, 31.2 s after it was asked for; it waited because: The price sellers ask was received 32.7 s ago; it may be at most 15 s old.

steps.name: the payment settles once after the restart, and the books agree with the rail
steps.expected: done; entries out and settle once each; reconciled; receipt issued
steps.observed: done; entries out, settle; compared with the rail: reconciled; receipt issued; settled 91 s after the crash

steps.name: exactly the payment and the purchase left the bank account
steps.expected: bank lower by ₹800 plus exactly what the buy entries took; the buy cost at most the ₹500 asked
steps.observed: bank moved by 1245.01 rupees: payment 800.00, purchase 445.01

steps.name: the instruction asks before its first run
revoking cancels the waiting run at once, and it can no longer be approved
steps.observed: run cancelled: You revoked the instruction before this run started.; approval request afterwards: 409 not_waiting

steps.name: with the API dead the engine still runs the instruction on schedule
steps.expected: API unreachable; at least one run done in that time
steps.observed: API health unreachable; runs started while it was down: done at 12:05:00

steps.name: minutes later the revoked instruction has started nothing and executed nothing
steps.expected: no action ever created for it

steps.name: an order the engine could not start within its limit is refused, not sent late
steps.expected: refused on started-in-time; no venue order; bank unchanged
steps.observed: blocked: The price sellers ask was received 2 min 46 s ago; it may be at most 15 s old. Failing checks: price-fresh, started-in-time; new venue orders 0; bank moved by 0 paise

steps.name: after two crashes of the engine and one of the API the records are whole
steps.expected: every entry balances; no reference used twice; nothing disagrees with a venue; nothing left reserved; receipt numbers unbroken
steps.observed: 0 unbalanced entries; 0 duplicated references; 0 records disagreeing with a venue; 0 reservations still open; 4 receipts numbered 1 to 4

steps.name: both periods without an engine are on record
